name: helper-module-initialization
goal: Preserve cold entrypoint initialization when colocating helpers and retaining public forwarding exports

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Moving catalogFilter in 59f243b5 and retaining the public forwarding export in cbf84d62 created a module cycle. Browser startup and a native Bun cold import of the public entry fail because orders reads byName before its const initialization.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing catalog tests import the owner module first and reuse a warm Vitest graph. Extend the same standardized catalog suite with native fresh-runtime loading and a catalogFilter call through both public and owner entrypoints.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only commit 20c7fdb5 fails a fresh public-entry import with the observed byName initialization error. Immutable red ec50fc3a2da3e9036451d2a72174be9ce243757ec8753aee090f476f6d37ae77 preserves the unchanged catalog suite and exact command.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Keep the comparator shared and public APIs intact; declare it as a hoisted function so either side of the forwarding cycle can initialize. The existing catalog suite must execute both entries in fresh native runtimes, and the helper-move review rule must require that coverage.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: The shared comparator is now a hoisted declaration. Public forwarding exports and owner-local placement remain intact. The standardized catalog suite exercises native cold initialization through both entries; the existing helper-move skill checkpoint now requires that proof.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
